blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday urged teachers to continue forming Filipinos who are “discerning in thought, principled in action, and mindful of the common good” as the country marked National Teachers’ Day. In a message honoring educators, Marcos recognized their role in shaping young Filipinos and helping them reach their potential.
